preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 50,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 150,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer ai on the vertices must be between 0 and n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must involve valid vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(u == v or u in ancestors[v] for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, u must be an ancestor of v or equal to v.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) for answer in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output line must contain an integer representing the answer to the query.

postconditions.expression: all(answer == max(a[i] ^ dist(i, v) for i in path(u, v)) for answer, (u, v) in zip(stdout, queries))
postconditions.description: Each output must be the maximum value of a[i] XOR dist(i, v) for all vertices i on the path from u to v.
